purpose: Provenance and pins for the B1 Verus model of IPM load and transaction history (crates/ipm-load-history).

toolchain.verus_state_machines_macros: =0.0.0-2026-09-06-0133 (declared in the workspace; not used by this crate)
toolchain.build: offline (CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true), cargo-verus from the Verus directory, --num-threads 4

explorer.reason: Explicit-state BFS explorer over the executable twins generated by exec_spec_verified!; fits a finite, deterministic-per-configuration machine with nondeterministic process ends, caller ends and foreign edits. It is plain Rust (no Verus proofs); a bug in it can hide a counterexample but cannot make a false property verify. Its results are bounded evidence.
explorer.trust: Unverified Rust. Results are labelled exhaustive only when the run reports truncated=false within the declared domain.

vendor/explorer/Cargo.toml.modification: workspace-inherited version/edition replaced by the upstream workspace values 0.1.0/2021 so the vendored copy builds as a path dependency

vendor/explorer/Cargo.toml.upstream.note: verbatim upstream manifest kept for comparison

actors.reason: crates/actors models clusters of stateless nodes over one store whose requests commit all effects atomically in their own transaction (obligation O2), with idempotency keys, an outbox and leased jobs. IPM load/history is one process running nested IRIS transactions (TSTART/TCOMMIT/TROLLBACK 1 with deferred inner commits), developer-mode intermediate commits, an IRISTEMP side log that deliberately escapes rollback, and %OnClose-driven persistence. None of the actor obligations or theorems apply to that shape; instantiating Domain would force the non-atomic behaviour under study into an atomic step. The transaction and process semantics are modelled directly in model.rs instead (premises P-01..P-08).
